title: What if the AI companies are anime girls?
gist: A short, humorous SemiWiki forum thread in which a user says they could not use up their monthly plan's tokens and so turned AI companies into anime girls; a reply quips that it is a good month to be in the token usage business. Text has no substantive analysis.

insights.claim: A forum user reports being unable to use up the tokens in their monthly AI plan, anecdotally suggesting some subscribers leave allotted usage unspent.
insights.speaker: B
insights.so_what: Single anecdote; weak signal on subscription utilization.
insights.quote: I can't use up all my monthly plan's tokens
insights.locator: What if the AI companies are anime girls?

insights.claim: A reply remarks that this month is a good time to be in the token usage business, a tongue-in-cheek nod to demand for AI token consumption.
insights.speaker: Barnsley
insights.so_what: Sentiment datapoint only; no data offered.
